title: Sent wrong shakers TWICE!!
text: Sent wrong shakers TWICE!!. I too had problems with receiving the wrong salt and pepper shakers.  They were in the shape of turkeys and unattractive.  I don't know if anyone reads the reason why you return something because they did this twice and from reading the other reviews I was not the only one this happened to.

product_metadata.title: Churchill China Thanksgiving Turkey Full Color Salt and Pepper Set
features: Detailed turkey design from original engravings
Reproduced with traditional transfer printing methods
Perfect for casual or formal dining
description: Thanksgiving Turkey Multi Coloured dinnerware is produced by utilising the centuries old art of transfer printing from an original engravings which bring to life the Turkey which we all associate with the traditional Thanksgiving Holiday. We at Churchill try to bring the best out in our designs by reproducing our ceramics the way our forefathers did in the 18th Century. Each Piece is processed and handled at least 50 times before it is finally made ready for our customers. This vintage feel is applied to this pair of Salt & Pepper Shakers perfect for either Casual or Formal Dining. Manufactured in fine Earthenware, Thanksgiving Turkey products are both Microwave & Dishwasher safe. This collection is endorsed by Churchill China with its 200 years of history in the manufacture of dinnerware for the home.

Transfer printed from original engravings, the Thanksgiving Turkey multi-colored salt and pepper set is decorated with a vibrant turkey illustration and is perfect for either casual or formal holiday dining. For a vintage look and feel, these shakers are made using traditional transfer printing methods dating back to the 18th century. Each piece is processed and handled at least fifty times. Manufactured in fine earthenware, Thanksgiving Turkey products are both microwave and dishwasher safe. Churchill China has been manufacturing dinnerware for the home for 200 years.
